operator_comparison.protocol: Six row pairs; eager submission and capture/replay.32 pairs/batch,two warm batches,seven retained batches. Baseline/activation-only/activation+tail/baseline on each backend.
operator_comparison.caveat: Microbenchmark with shared FP16 weights, not a model. Submission overlaps GPU execution; completion-minus-submission is not exclusive GPU time. No device timestamps.

interpretation.evidence: Initial native B also slowed unchanged Short: prefill 1367.0ms versus A0/A1 925.4/939.9ms. Native warm screen and independent reverse confirmation are reported separately; old samples retained.
interpretation.causal_attribution: Not isolated. Explicit prefill warmup and repeated controlled cohorts change the observed native result; this does not prove warmup alone caused the initial regression.
interpretation.runtime_difference: Native batches 64 mixed operations by default and uses owner handoffs/local parameter uploads. L0 uses its own submission path. Source differences are not causal proof.

limitations: Two retained samples per case/arm in warm screen, one in reverse confirmation; no confidence interval
Performance applies to tested 2K prefill cases; no general decode/long-context claim
Historical benchmark cumulative MTP floor 0 differs from production 0.5
6561 is the requested experiment capacity; production auto sizing/reserve are unchanged
1 Hz physical-memory sampling cannot bound the instantaneous minimum or exclude WDDM paging; READY uses another counter

capacity_adoption.reason: Initial screen minimum735.8MiB; independent native confirmation minimum711.8MiB. Both below the earlier1024MiB physical-headroom criterion.
